FIELD GUIDE

A good deed.
A little adventure.

You found a lost phone. Unscramble five destinations to lift the map and meet its fictional owner.

  1. Read the free clue and word length. Type a destination and press Enter or Check answer.
  2. Every solved destination removes one map piece. There are exactly five.
  3. Each level starts at 100 points: −10 per full-length wrong guess and −20 per paid letter hint. Each level has a zero-point floor.
  4. You have three paid hints for the entire journey. Each reveals the next letter in position. Shuffle is free.
  5. After three wrong guesses, an extra clue appears for free. Empty or incomplete answers cost nothing.

No timer. Unlimited attempts. Up to 500 points. Your progress saves automatically; use Resume on this browser.

A fictional phone-unlocking story, not a real unlocking tool.
